answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 36 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in crystal, verified in vine, and pearl names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 7 hours of verification and 8 percent more locked value.
